answer: The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. The inlet report publishes the merge explicitly at each tundra. Each collapsed cluster gets one jade weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A 185 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
